name: qwen3.5-9b
notes:
Hybrid stack: 24 linear-attention (Gated DeltaNet, module linear_attn) + 8 full-attention (self_attn) layers, every 4th full. Checkpoint is the vision-language Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; AutoModelForCausalLM (transformers 5.19) loads the text model Qwen3_5ForCausalLM and skips the vision tower and the MTP head. Needs transformers >= 5 (container default is 4.57.1), hence the separate env in 'python'. Thinking off through the template's own enable_thinking=false (renders '<think>

</think>

' after the generation prompt; the default would open '<think>
'). The ModelScope download has no generation_config.json, so generation would stop only at <|endoftext|> (248044) and not at the chat template's end-of-turn <|im_end|> (248046); generation_config sets the stop IDs to [248046, 248044], the values the Qwen3.8-27B checkpoint ships with (core/qa_prompt_das.turn_terminator_ids refuses to run otherwise).
